en.description:
Seeking a coloring experience that transcends mere relaxation and unlocks the depths of your creativity? Look no further than Soul Color, the innovative paint by number game designed to nourish your soul and ignite your artistic spirit.

More than just coloring by numbers: Soul Color goes beyond the traditional by offering a multi-faceted experience that caters to the artist within:

Uncover Your Soul's Color Palette: We offer a curated collection of stunning artworks that evoke a wide range of emotions. Explore vibrant landscapes, serene mandalas, captivating portraits, and more – each designed to resonate with your unique inner world.

Journey Through Color Therapy: Each image in Soul Color is meticulously chosen to promote emotional well-being.  Color alongside calming music and guided meditations, allowing the act of coloring to become a form of self-care and a path to inner peace.

A Haven for Relaxation and Self-Care: Escape the daily grind and immerse yourself in a tranquil coloring sanctuary. Soul Color provides a soothing retreat where you can unwind, de-stress, and reconnect with your inner self.

Beyond the features, Soul Color offers:

- Exquisite Artwork: We collaborate with talented artists worldwide to bring you a diverse and ever-expanding library of high-quality illustrations.
- Intuitive Interface: Enjoy a user-friendly design that is easy to navigate for artists of all skill levels.
- Regular Updates: We are constantly adding new content, features, and challenges to keep your artistic journey fresh and exciting.
- Personalized Daily Horoscope Coloring: Combine horoscope readings with coloring activities to generate daily personalized horoscope content and related coloring images.
- Apple Watch Integration: View daily and cumulative coloring data on Apple Watch, including time spent coloring and completed images. Set your favorite coloring images as a watch face for added personalization.

Soul Color is more than just a coloring app – it's a portal to self-discovery, a haven for relaxation, and a platform for artistic expression.

Download Soul Color today and embark on a journey of color, creativity, and inner peace.

Soul Color provides three auto-renewing subscription options. They are $4.99 for a week, $9.99 for a month, and $69.99 for a year.

If you choose to purchase Soul Color Pro, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Privacy Policy: http://soulcolor.gpower2012.com/file/iOS/privacyPolicy.html
Terms of Use: http://soulcolor.gpower2012.com/file/iOS/termsofuse.html

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
This update brings you more color choices and greater freedom of expression. Soul Color aims to help you paint the colors of your inner world, whether you feel joy, sadness, anger, or tranquility.



What's New:

- New Patterns and Images: An expanded library of images covering various themes and styles to help you better express your emotions and thoughts.

Performance Improvements:

- Improved startup speed and smoother operation.
- Fixed known bugs to enhance overall stability.
This update brings optimizations and improvements to enhance your gaming experience.
All text fonts are enlarged for better accessibility, especially friendly to the elderly.
